the capacity of hybrid networks scales linearly with the base station density if the number of base station grows faster than √ n.
the capacity of hybrid networks scales linearly with the base station density if the number of nodes is sufficiently large.
the throughput capacity of the hybrid network scales as m/n, where m is the number of base-stations in the system and n is the number of nodes.

the study of the capacity of a hybrid wireless network.
the study of the scaling behavior of hybrid networks and the capacity improvement that can be obtained by adding a sparse infrastructure to a random ad hoc wireless network.
the study of the capacity of hybrid networks and the design of efficient routing protocols to achieve high performance.
